context.surface: A local editor server exposes a state-changing control operation for its own interface.
assumptions: Use disposable local fixtures and synthetic inputs.

review.invariant: The same request policy allows the intended control operation from an authorized local client.
review.verification: Check that the normal local control still succeeds after the policy rejection test. Run the server suite to verify ordinary request behavior.

source_observation.summary: The intended control passed within the targeted regression. The full recorded run reported 321 passes across its suites and two ignored tests. The served editor asset was a build placeholder.
